name: Ron Tototz
summary: Larry's bunk mate — "he's Polish" — identified by Larry in VN-0002 (right, chin on hand) and VN-0003 (left of Kahn). Ron was with Larry during the bathroom shooting incident, which Larry believes ended in a court martial for the shooter. His real surname is unknown; "Tototz" is a phonetic transcription of how Larry says it.
larrysRecollection: Right: Ron Tototz. He's polish and was with me during the shooting incident in the bathroom. Ron was my bunk mate. The guy that shot would have been court martialed, there should be a record. (VN-0002 Memories comment, 2026-08-13)
researchNotes: A findable witness if the real name can be recovered. Two document paths could yield the spelling: the court-martial record Larry expects to exist from the bathroom shooting (roughly February–March 1965 by his dating), and unit morning reports via NPRC once the unit is confirmed. Polish surname candidates to try in searches: Totos, Totosz, Totusz, Totowicz.
